name: Capacity Events in Real-Time Hub (RTH) - Overview Events
description: **Capacity Events in Fabric Real-Time Hub (RTH)****Capacity Events in RTH ** provides near-real-time telemetry for Fabric capacities, enabling admins to monitor, troubleshoot, and automate capacity management with low latency.  This Preview includes Overview Events (e.g., 'Capacity Overview' event group) which encompasses the **Capacity Summary** and **Capacity State** events.  Capacity Summary shows capacity usage at a given moment, calculated using a 30-second smoothed utilization of the capacity.  Capacity State captures changes in capacity due to different actions, such as switching to a paused state or becoming overloaded due to throttling.  By utilizing Eventhouse, admins can perform deeper analysis - while Activator can enable real-time actions and alerts without writing any code.  Admins can also integrate with a system of their choice.  Ultimately, these events provide deeper understanding of a capacity, helping administrators monitor overall health and utilization and rapidly take action to keep their capacities healthy.
